_note: Curated NEPSE closure seed for tools/build-calendar-events.js — the single source from which data/calendar-events.json, tools/nepse-holidays.json and nepse-data-archive/nepse-holidays.txt are generated. Weekday closures only (Sat/Sun are the standing weekend rule, never entries). Status values: 'verified' = confirmed in our records against NEPSE/session evidence; 'gazette' = on the Government of Nepal gazette holiday list for BS 2083 (corroborated by at least two published mirrors of the gazette on 2026-10-23) and NEPSE follows the government calendar, but no NEPSE notice has been sighted yet; 'estimate' = forward festival date from our own forward list / festival calendars, gazette for BS 2084 not yet published. Community-specific and Kathmandu-Valley-only holidays that NEPSE does not observe (Indra Jatra 2026-09-25 was a trading day) are deliberately excluded. Islamic holidays are gazetted separately on lunar sighting and are added when announced.
